result.title: Adaptive Multi-Token Prediction: How far should we go?
result.summary: Multi-token prediction (MTP) can accelerate language-model decoding by drafting several tokens and verifying them in a single target-model pass. However, the best speculation horizon changes with context: longer drafts offer greater amortization when reliable, but can waste compute on suffixes discarded after a rejection. Unlike autoregressive drafting, where a stopping rule can decide token by token, MTP must fix the horizon before drafting, as all heads fire in the same forward pass. We therefore formulate horizon selection as an online control problem, using verification feedback to learn how far the draft can be trusted in each context, and introduce Adaptive Multi-Token Prediction (AMTP): a lightweight controller that requires no retraining and leaves the exact verifier unchanged. To guide horizon selection, we characterize the expected number of tokens committed at each horizon via acceptance survival, the probability that a draft prefix is fully accepted. Before each round, AMTP predicts how far the draft is likely to survive and picks the horizon with the highest expected tokens per second, learning freely from every verification pass. Theoretically, we show that any online learner's prediction error translates into throughput regret against the best horizon for each context, and in turn into a bound on wall-clock completion time. With online gradient descent, this regret is sublinear. Across five draft-target pairings built on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with Medusa heads, Meta's MTP models, and Qwen3-4B-Inst-2507-MTP, evaluated on AIME 2025 and GSM8K, AMTP decodes up to 4.1x faster than standard decoding and matches or outperforms the fixed window in 8 of 10 settings, with throughput gains of up to 10%.

AI.brief_summary: 论文将多 token 预测的投机长度选择建模为在线控制问题，用验证反馈预测各上下文下草稿前缀的接受存活概率，提出无需重训、不改动验证器的轻量控制器 AMTP，按每秒期望提交 token 数选择 horizon，并给出吞吐 regret 与完成时间的理论界；在 Llama-3.1、Medusa、Qwen3-MTP 等组合上取得最高约 4.1 倍解码加速。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「以验证反馈在线预测草稿可存活多长、据此调配计算量」的机制，可能为 latent 推理中 STOP 决策、动态计算预算与长度泛化预测提供可核查的借鉴线索，但研究对象是纯文本投机解码加速，与视觉证据或内部状态表示无直接关联。
